electron.reason: postinstall downloads the Electron binary from GitHub releases, caching the zip under the user's cache (writing its own folder needs no grant)

puppeteer.reason: postinstall downloads Chrome for Testing into the user's cache

@prisma/engines.reason: postinstall downloads the query and schema engines for this platform (into its own folder, which needs no grant), caching them under the user's cache

playwright.reason: `playwright install` downloads browsers into the user's cache
